status: Accepted by Claude and Codex; capability-gated implementation

rules.confirmation: Write actions accept confirm=false by default and return a side-effect preview; confirm=true does not imply dirty-state discard.
rules.read_only: Read-only policy operates per action; grouped read actions remain available.
rules.operation_waits: Mutating handlers may return queued operation IDs; long waits never occupy the STA worker.
rules.capabilities: Register only actions appropriate to the enabled profile and proven backend capabilities.
rules.dispatch: Validate inputs/roots/evidence first; no arbitrary COM paths or methods.
rules.schema_note: inputSchema is the flat client discovery schema. validationSchema is the strict server-only schema; validate the selected action before dispatch. Never publish validationSchema as inputSchema.
rules.epoch: Carry the epoch of the relevant previously returned ID snapshot or preview; check at backend dispatch. No client epoch parameter. On stale_session re-read list/summary and retry; never authorize old IDs using a silently refreshed epoch. Backend contracts.py v0.2 provides atomic snapshot/context guards.
